summary: TRACK 15.75B Shop/Pre-Op/DVIR delivery certification CERTIFIED. Full regression matrix called out by main agent (15.75B + 15.75A + 15.74 + 15.73Q) = 17/17 backend tests PASSED in 7.72s. critical_code_review_comments: TRACK 15.75B fix is surgically scoped: the shop_routing_unresolved escalation block and the shop_preop_dispatch audit-write block both fire only AFTER the iter238 hard-override has executed, preserving the 'Pre-Op emails go to Shop Manager only — no PM, no office CC' contract.

Both audit-write paths (success branch writing status='sent' with resend_message_id, failure branch writing status='failed' with error string) close the previous P1 'log-only' trust gap — every Pre-Op / DVIR send now produces an email_routing_audit_v2 row the operator can prove.

The P0 silent-failure case (empty recipients + no PRE_OP_FAIL_FALLBACK + no SHOP_MANAGER_EMAIL env) is now defended by the shop_routing_unresolved branch: a truthful audit row is written and ADMIN_DEAD_LETTER_TO is consulted via pm_routing._dead_letter_recipients before Resend is invoked, so a 400 'no recipients' can no longer be swallowed silently.

Live preview DB carries the canonical fixtures: an active 'Shop Manager' role user with email shopmanager@mascigc.com (asserted in test_shop_manager_resolution_prefers_active_role_user) AND a non-empty masci::PRE_OP_FAIL_FALLBACK route document (asserted in test_pre_op_fail_fallback_route_configured), so the escalation chain is functionally exercisable in production.

Admin gate on /api/shop/command-feed correctly enforces portal authentication: 401 'Portal authentication required' for both unauth and bogus-token requests, 200 only for a valid super-admin X-Admin-Token. No PII leak path identified.
Test isolation is clean: every audit-row test self-cleans via delete_one in a try/finally block, no orphan rows left in email_routing_audit_v2.
test_credentials: Super-admin token generated at runtime via user_directory.make_directory_admin_token() against jaymn.judd@mascigc.com user row (password_hash bound). Token format: <user_id>.<hmac_hex>, length 101 chars. Not persisted in this report for security; regenerate via the snippet in the original request.
